title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.


About SigmaMD


SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.


About this role


We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.


Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.


This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.


And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.


You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.


What you'll do


Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.


Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.


Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.


Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.


Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.


What we're looking for


1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.


2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to \"who decides this?\" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.


3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.


4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.


Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.


Who you might be


You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.


Nice to have


  • Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.
  • Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).
  • Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.


Our values


Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.

  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.
  • Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant iQIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.
  • Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.
  • Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms.
  • Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America.
  • Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams.
  • Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models.
  • Mandarin Chinese.
  • Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.


Employment conditions and benefits

  • Permanent CLT employment agreement.
  • Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law.
  • Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance.
  • Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance.
  • 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law.
  • Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

title: Ecommerce Designer (Landing Pages)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ecommerce Designer (Landing Pages) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a hands-on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Landing Page Specialist (Shopify) who is both a builder and an analyst. You'll design and build high-converting landing pages for paid media and influencer campaigns, while continuously optimizing website performance based on user behavior data.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and is comfortable working with a company whose Christian, pro-life values are reflected in its mission and culture.

  • Experience with A/B testing tools such as VWO or Optimizely .

title: Planejador Financeiro / Consultor de Investimentos (Pessoa Física)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Planejador Financeiro / Consultor de Investimentos (Pessoa Física) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: OSS PreSales Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para OSS PreSales Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role: Pre-Sales Solution Architect

Location: LATM Region

Responsibilities:

• Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity

qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract

award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional

pipeline.

• Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution

design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and

Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-

quality, fully compliant submissions.

• Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance,

Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping

theCompany portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes.

• Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-

quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise

reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including

customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone.

• Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management &

Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and

rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases

such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and

interference management, and anomaly detection.

• Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and

intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous

networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for

customers.

• Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution

integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use

cases, KPIs, and success criteria.

• Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level

designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand

customer and third-party technical scrutiny.

• Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery

workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical

stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level.

• Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery /

Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties –

operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble

winning and deliverable solutions.

• Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and

webinars – and representCompany at industry events and standards / community forums

such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE.

• Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs

and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the

shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer

conversations and internal strategy.

Requirements:

• Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:• Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and

storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear

business value.

• Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain

for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx

responses and customer-facing technical engagements.

• Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault,

performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management,

and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause

analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).

• Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop

assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum

Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).

• Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT

RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management

interfaces.

• Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS,

PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment

models.

• Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital

Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines,

telemetry, and data lakes).

• Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and

solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal

and external stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel as required.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Analista de negócios
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de negócios em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

✅ Business Analyst Salesforce (Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência – PCD)


100% Remoto | CLT


A OSF Digital é uma consultoria global especializada em transformação digital, com forte atuação em Salesforce, tecnologia e experiência do cliente.

Estamos com uma vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) para atuação como Business Analyst Salesforce, participando de projetos estratégicos nos segmentos de Energia e Automotivo (LATAM).

Buscamos profissionais que atuem como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia, contribuindo para que as soluções em Salesforce atendam às necessidades do negócio com qualidade, inovação e escalabilidade.


Principais responsabilidades

* Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos junto aos stakeholders;

* Mapear processos atuais (AS-IS) e futuros (TO-BE);

* Apoiar o desenho de soluções escaláveis na plataforma Salesforce;

* Realizar configurações declarativas na plataforma (Flows, Validation Rules, Objetos Customizados, Relatórios e Dashboards);

* Apoiar a execução de testes funcionais e testes de aceitação do usuário (UAT);

* Elaborar relatórios e dashboards para acompanhamento de indicadores;

* Apoiar iniciativas de qualidade e gestão de dados;

* Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio e equipes técnicas;

* Conduzir treinamentos e prestar suporte aos usuários finais.


✅ Requisitos

* Experiência como Business Analyst em projetos Salesforce;

* Conhecimento em Sales Cloud e/ou Service Cloud;

* Experiência com levantamento e documentação de requisitos;

* Vivência em mapeamento de processos (AS-IS e TO-BE);

* Facilidade para comunicação com stakeholders e equipes técnicas;

* Perfil analítico, organizado e colaborativo;

* Português fluente e inglês para atuação em ambiente corporativo.


⭐ Diferenciais

* Experiência em consultoria;

* Vivência nos segmentos de Energia, Automotivo ou Financeiro.


Modelo de contratação


✔ CLT

✔ 100% Remoto

✔ Pacote completo de benefícios


Inclusão e acessibilidade

Esta é uma vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD).

Na OSF Digital, valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que equipes inclusivas constroem soluções melhores. Incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais com deficiência e, caso você necessite de alguma adaptação durante qualquer etapa do processo seletivo, teremos satisfação em disponibilizar os recursos de acessibilidade necessários.


Se você possui experiência como Business Analyst Salesforce e deseja atuar em projetos globais com impacto estratégico, será um prazer conhecer sua trajetória.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs.

In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models.

This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently.


Key Responsibilities

As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will:

  • Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings.
  • Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio.
  • Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity.
  • Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable.
  • Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment.
  • Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally.
  • Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams.
  • Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency.


Required Language Proficiency

Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role.

Proficiency is required in:

  • Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task)
  • Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions)
  • Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases)

The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio.


Required Experience

The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas:

  • PII identification or privacy annotation
  • Risk assessment or content safety annotation
  • Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling
  • Named Entity Recognition or entity classification
  • LLM response evaluation
  • AI chatbot evaluation
  • Policy-based content moderation
  • Sensitive content classification
  • Gen AI or LLM training data creation

Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making.


Skills and Competencies

We are looking for candidates who have:

  • Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language.
  • Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills.
  • A close attention to detail and consistency.
  • Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately.
  • Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content.
  • Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup.
  • Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking.
  • Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains.
  • Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred.
  • Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage.


Engagement Terms

  • This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side.
  • Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down.
  • Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary.
  • Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept.


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects.
  • Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives.
  • Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development.


Application Note

This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

Event & Logistics Management

  • Manage invitations, attendance tracking, and event execution.
  • Ensure all programme and event requirements are met in line with established standards.


Reporting & Programme Analytics

  • Create and maintain dashboards that measure programme effectiveness and learner engagement.
  • Track participation, certification achievements, completion rates, and training outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate programme records and reporting databases.
  • Reconcile external reporting with internal programme records.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Prepare and maintain programme documentation and proof-of-execution records.

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Smartsheet.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Desirable

  • Experience supporting AI, technology, or enterprise sales enablement programmes.
  • Knowledge of certification programme administration.
  • Experience working with external vendors, training providers, and strategic partners.
  • Experience coordinating global programmes across multiple geographies and time zones.


Additional Information

  • No travel is required for this role.

title: Coordenador(a) de Monitoramento, Avaliação e Pesquisa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador(a) de Monitoramento, Avaliação e Pesquisa em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Liderar a estruturação, análise e disseminação de dados educacionais que orientam a tomada de decisão de secretarias parceiras e da própria organização. A pessoa será responsável por transformar dados brutos de avaliações e indicadores educacionais em análises rigorosas e acionáveis, além de contribuir para o desenho de interfaces e integrações que facilitem o acesso e uso desses dados por gestores públicos e equipes internas.

Reportando à Gerência da área, a pessoa atuará na interseção entre pesquisa aplicada, gestão de dados e advocacy local baseado em evidências, com forte interlocução com equipes de programas, tecnologia e parceiros institucionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


Monitoramento e análise de dados

  • Coordenar a coleta, estruturação e análise de dados de avaliações educacionais (ex: SAEB, avaliações estaduais/municipais, indicadores de fluxo e aprendizagem).
  • Desenvolver e manter modelos analíticos e preditores de resultados educacionais, conectando dados de insumo, processo e resultado.
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e atualização das bases de dados utilizadas pela organização e por parceiros.


Estruturação de ferramentas de dados

  • Contribuir para o desenho e a evolução de interfaces e painéis de visualização que tornem os dados acessíveis e compreensíveis para gestores de secretarias.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de tecnologia na definição de requisitos de integração entre diferentes fontes e sistemas de dados educacionais.
  • Traduzir necessidades de gestores públicos em especificações funcionais para novas funcionalidades analíticas.


Avaliação e pesquisa

  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações de processo e de resultado dos programas da organização.
  • Produzir estudos, notas técnicas e relatórios que subsidiem decisões estratégicas internas e de parceiros.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre literatura acadêmica e evidências em política educacional, aplicando-as ao contexto de atuação da organização.


Gestão de relacionamento e comunicação de dados

  • Apresentar análises e recomendações para lideranças de secretarias, conselho e financiadores, de forma clara e orientada à ação.
  • Apoiar a preparação de materiais para reuniões estratégicas, conselhos e eventos externos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de programa para garantir uso efetivo dos dados na gestão escolar e na formulação de políticas.


Gestão de equipe e processos

  • Coordenar analista(s) e/ou estagiário(s) da área de monitoramento e avaliação.
  • Estabelecer rotinas e protocolos de qualidade para produção e validação de análises.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Economia, Estatística, Ciências Sociais, Educação, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados educacionais, avaliação de políticas públicas ou pesquisa aplicada.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (ex: Stata, R, Python ou SQL).
  • Experiência com bases de microdados educacionais (Censo Escolar, INEP, SAEB, avaliações estaduais) é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de traduzir análises complexas em recomendações claras para públicos não técnicos.
  • Vivência em desenho ou especificação de painéis/dashboards e interfaces de dados (não é necessário programar as ferramentas, mas sim saber especificar requisitos junto a times técnicos).
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e oral, com experiência em produção de relatórios e apresentações.


Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação (mestrado ou doutorado) em Economia, Educação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência prévia em organizações do terceiro setor, secretarias de educação ou instituições de pesquisa educacional.
  • Conhecimento de métodos de avaliação de impacto (ex: diferenças em diferenças, matching, regressão descontínua).
  • Familiaridade com o ecossistema de tecnologia educacional (EdTech) e ferramentas de IA aplicadas à educação.

title: Operations Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WANTED! The World's Most Driven Remote Operations Specialist


About Chore

Chore exists to kill admin so founders can \"Chore No More\" and build their dreams. We are the end of admin. We are the future. We are the better world for everyone.

We exist to make every startup in the world successful. The more startups that exist, survive and thrive, the better the world we all get to live in. We work behind the scenes to help our clients win.

We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We're transparent with each other and with our clients. We're professional, inclusive and autonomous, and we're building a culture that's trust-based, genuinely fun, and pushes each of us to keep learning.

Check out more of what we do here:


🚀 The Role

We're looking for a driven person to join our team of Operations Specialists - the main conduit through which all of our clients' back-office operations run , including Human Resources, Finance, Payroll and Compliance.

As an Operations Specialist, you work directly with US startup founders to project manage their most critical operational matters. You work alongside a Chief Chore Officer, who owns the relationship - you own the operations. In short: you're the point person who keeps the lights on.

These responsibilities are often tactical. But tactical doesn't mean thoughtless - and as you build trusted relationships with the founders you support, the work becomes strategic too. Our best Operations Specialists end up being the person a founder calls first.


Some Examples Of The Work We Do

  • Tactical responsibilities still require judgment and thoughtfulness - “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
  • Work that gets genuinely strategic - e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times, when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.
  • Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases. An unusual filing. A regulator with an unhelpful website. A vendor who's gone quiet. Something that has genuinely never come up before. You go and find the answer
  • Choosing tools and vendors, with the cost in mind. Our clients are early-stage and often bootstrapped. You research the options, compare them properly, and recommend what actually fits their budget - not the biggest name in the market. We expect you to know what things cost and to raise it before anyone asks you to.
  • Contributing to our knowledge base. Internal, client-facing, and public-facing. Every startup on earth reinvents the wheel on HR, Finance and Legal Ops, and it drives us crazy. We're building a reusable source of wisdom and best practice - and what you learn goes into it, so nobody has to solve the same problem twice.
  • Internal projects that make Chore stronger. SOPs, systems, dashboards, operational improvements - scoped, executed and delivered by you.


One note on scope: unlike an internal Chief of Staff, this role doesn't extend into bespoke areas like go-to-market, analytics or partnerships.


🧠 What We're Looking For


Required

  • 3+ years of work experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties. This is required, not preferred. What matters most is that you were the person responsible for outcomes, not a contributor to someone else's.


Strongly preferred

  • HR, Payroll, Finance or Compliance operations experience (We're not looking for a recruitment or sales background)


And you're probably a fit if…

  • You're a total geek for better processes - more standardisation, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient.
  • Ticking items off your list while thinking \"how could I do this more efficiently?\" brings a smile to your face. There's always more to do for clients, and you thrive on getting things done
  • You're obsessed with using AI and technology to work smarter - you don't wait to be told about a new tool, you've usually already tested it
  • You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries
  • You're smart, detail-oriented, a natural context-switcher, with GREAT communication skills
  • You have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by people - going above and beyond to make sure our clients love us
  • You can focus in stressful situations and prioritise almost automatically
  • You're open to giving and receiving feedback , up, down and sideways, using the Radical Candor method
  • You start solving before you start asking. When something breaks and there's nobody available, you get going. You escalate with a recommendation, not a question
  • You don't mind the unsexy part of running a startup - dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboardings, and basically doing the \"startup plumber\" work. It might smell, but a strong back office is foundational to success
  • You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long term (2+ years). This role might be a stepping stone, and we celebrate our team members' growth - but if you apply, our assumption is that you'd prefer a job you can see yourself in for several years over one you expect to leave within twelve months

Nice to have, not required

  • An understanding of bookkeeping, accounting, or early-stage startup finance
  • Comfort with ClickUp, Slack, Notion, and Google Suite


Why This Role Is Special

  • You will run real companies behind the scenes. Very few roles give you this much impact this early
  • You get ownership from day one. From the moment you start, you are running real systems for real companies - not shadowing or waiting to be handed responsibility
  • You get rare visibility. You'll see how multiple US startups actually operate behind the scenes. Operators almost never get this
  • You work with sharp, ambitious teammates who care deeply about doing things well
  • You will grow faster than you imagined - start by partnering with experienced Chief of Staffs


Compensation & Logistics

  • Compensation. We believe in full transparency. Below is what we pay by market, with quarterly bonuses of up to 30% based on performance.
  • India - $12K USD/year
  • Nigeria / Africa - $10.4K USD/year
  • LATAM - $13K USD/year

Note : we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.

  • Equity. All team members receive equity. Further grants are awarded based on performance and tenure.
  • Benefits (all eligible after you complete the 60-day probation period)
  • Up to $250/month WFH stipend
  • Up to $50/month wellness stipend
  • Location. We're remote-first and proud of it. If you're good with our compensation and US working hours, the world is yours.
  • Schedule. US business hours, Eastern or Pacific Time. This is mandatory and it can be challenging. If you can't consistently work EST or PST hours, this role won't be a good fit.


🦨 Read Before Applying

We believe in being upfront about the hard parts.

  • US hours are required and can be demanding. This may not be suitable for everyone
  • Remote work has real challenges. You need reliable WiFi, power backup, and a quiet workspace
  • High ambiguity. You must create structure, not wait for it
  • Extreme context-switching. You'll juggle multiple clients, internal stakeholders and projects at the same time
  • Feedback fluency. You must be comfortable giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways
  • High ownership. Minimal hand-holding. You are expected to self-manage
  • Client-facing pressure. Founders move fast and expect clarity
  • 60-day fully paid probation period. We want everyone to feel set up for success from day one. In your first 60 days, success looks like confidently owning and running core client workflows with minimal oversight and communicating proactively with clients and teammates.


If this energizes you rather than intimidates you, you're probably a great fit.


❤️ Our Values

  • Delight All Stakeholders. Make work feel easier, clearer and more thoughtful for clients, teammates and yourself
  • Meritocracy. We reward value created - not longevity
  • Experiment & Adapt. Try things, learn fast, improve continuously
  • Assume Good Intentions. Take feedback well. Fix things proactively. Be a force multiplier


How to Apply (READ CAREFULLY)


Please read this section carefully - following the instructions is part of how we assess applications.

Your application has two parts. Both are required.


Step 1 - Record a short video

Record one video, no longer than 3 minutes , answering these two questions:

1. Why is this role not a good fit for most people, and why is it for you?

2. Pick something from the last three years that was yours to lead on your own - not something you supported someone else on. Tell us what you decided, who else was involved and what they did, and what it cost or saved.

A few notes:

  • Answer both questions in a single video (loom preferred)
  • We're not judging production quality - we want to hear how you think
  • We appreciate the use of AI. We don't want AI-generated answers (trust us, we can tell). Tell us your story, in your own words, please.


Step 2 - Submit the application form

(Only once your video is recorded)


Form:

When sharing your resume, please name as follows: Firstname.Lastname.OS - Resume - for example, Jane.Doe.OS - Resume. PDF preferred.


What Happens Next

We move quickly, and we'd rather you know exactly what's coming:

  • We review your application and video - usually within a week
  • A 30-minute screening call , so we can get to know you
  • A paid case study - 1 to 2 hours of work, with 72 hours to complete it. You'll receive a payment for your time
  • Four interviews , to meet different team members including a Chief Chore Officer (30 mins), a current Operations Specialist (30 mins), our head of Client Operations (30 mins) and finally our CEO (15 mins)
  • Offer rollout


We aim to go from application to decision in around three weeks.

conversations and internal strategy.

storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear

business value.

for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx

responses and customer-facing technical engagements.

performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management,

and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause

analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance).

assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum

Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5).

RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management

PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment

and external stakeholders.

About Us

At HBX Group , we are a global TravelTech ecosystem connecting and empowering businesses across the world of travel. Through data, innovation, and strong partnerships, we deliver seamless experiences and help our partners grow.

Within our Activities division, we focus on building competitive, high-quality product portfolios that meet evolving market demands. Our teams operate in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where ownership, adaptability, and collaboration are key to success.


Job Summary

As a Contract Manager , you will be responsible for managing and optimizing a portfolio of suppliers, ensuring the product remains competitive, available, and aligned with market needs.

This role combines supplier relationship management, negotiation, reporting, and operational execution , with a strong focus on performance tracking, prioritization, and continuous improvement . You will work closely with internal teams and external partners to drive revenue, maintain product quality, and unlock growth opportunities.


Job Responsibilities

Supplier & Portfolio Management

  • Manage a portfolio of Activities suppliers, ensuring product availability and competitiveness at all times.
  • Maintain and develop strong relationships with suppliers, acting as the main point of contact.

Contracting & Negotiation

  • Negotiate commercial conditions including rates, inventory, offers, and contract terms.

  • Benchmark competitors and proactively renegotiate where needed to maintain market positioning.


Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze portfolio performance through bi-weekly reports and statistics , identifying trends and opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and take actions to improve conversion, revenue, and product performance.
  • Provide insights and explanations on portfolio performance using data and market knowledge.


Operational Excellence

  • Manage multiple processes simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and quality.
  • Prioritize tasks effectively based on business impact and deadlines.
  • Maintain updated product content (rates, inclusions, descriptions, availability).
  • Solve operational issues and coordinate solutions with internal teams and suppliers.


Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders (Sales, Operations, Revenue, Product teams).
  • Support cross-functional initiatives and ensure alignment on commercial priorities.
  • Represent HBX Group in supplier meetings and market visits.


Required Skills

  • Strong prioritization and time management , with the ability to manage multiple processes simultaneously.
  • High level of analytical thinking , comfortable working with reports, data, and performance metrics.
  • Strong commercial mindset with negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills .
  • High attention to detail and process discipline, with flexibility to manage changing priorities.
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work independently.


Required Tech Skills

  • Intermediate Excel skills (data analysis, reporting, tracking KPIs).
  • Experience working with internal systems, contracting tools, or booking platforms .
  • Ability to analyze data and translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards is a plus.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 1–3+ years of experience in contracting, sourcing, account management, or similar roles.
  • Experience in travel, tourism, or supplier management is highly preferred.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese for communication with global teams.
  • Availability to travel as part of supplier relationship management.

Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference

  • Demonstrated experience leading Agile delivery for data, analytics, software, technology, or digital-product teams.
  • Hands-on experience with multiple delivery frameworks, including Scrum, sprint-based delivery, Kanban, and hybrid Agile approaches.

  • Proven accountability for project timelines, milestones, prioritization, dependencies, risks, and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams, product backlogs, or releases.

  • Experience working with globally distributed and remote development teams across multiple time zones.
  • Experience working in a GxP-validated system, regulated environment, controlled SDLC, or environment with comparable validation, documentation, testing, traceability, and change-control requirements.
  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.


Key Responsibilities


1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.


2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.


3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble


4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.


  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.


5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.


6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.


7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.


8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology


9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.


10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery


Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.


Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.


Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

  • Liderar e influenciar stakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio , com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais;
  • Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos);
  • Experiência sólida na gestão, priorização e refinamento de roadmaps e backlogs usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Comunicação clara, articulada e excelente habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência ou interesse prático na aplicação de soluções de IA (Inteligência Artificial) , LLMs ou automações avançadas no dia a dia do produto;
  • Experiência com sistemas corporativos e integrações complexas (ex: ERPs como SAP, CRMs, ferramentas de Analytics);
  • Domínio de ferramentas analíticas (SQL, Power BI, Tableau ou similares);
  • Histórico em projetos de transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados.


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias;
  • Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto;
  • Capacidade de entrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue;
  • Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Business Analyst

Role Overview

The Information Management Team at our corporate client uses industry best practices to deliver analytical platforms, data management capabilities, and business intelligence solutions that support business needs. The team works closely with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, translate requirements into practical technology solutions, and improve the efficiency and quality of services delivered to customers.

The Senior IT Business Analyst will serve as the primary liaison between international business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. This person will be responsible for understanding business needs, documenting requirements, supporting solution delivery, and helping business and technical teams maintain a shared understanding of project goals.

The ideal candidate has strong business analysis and project delivery experience within an IT environment. Experience supporting data teams, data platforms, reporting initiatives, business intelligence solutions, or data-related projects is preferred. The Business Analyst should be comfortable working with technology teams and discussing technical concepts but is not required to be a hands-on technical specialist, developer, or advanced SQL user.


Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, and project team members.
  • Lead and support requirements-gathering sessions with business stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Understand business objectives, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable business and functional requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements documents, functional requirements, process flows, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, and related project documentation.
  • Facilitate structured walkthroughs and reviews of requirements with business stakeholders and project team members.
  • Work with business and technology teams to clarify requirements, resolve questions, and maintain alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Evaluate business requests to determine scope, feasibility, dependencies, risks, and potential solution options.
  • Support projects involving data, reporting, business intelligence, data warehousing, or information management.
  • Work with business stakeholders to define reporting needs, business rules, data definitions, and expected outcomes.
  • Assist business and technology teams in identifying data-related issues and documenting potential solutions.
  • Support the development and refinement of project backlogs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in project planning, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Support user acceptance testing by developing test scenarios, coordinating business participation, documenting results, and tracking issues through resolution.
  • Assist with change management, implementation planning, troubleshooting, and post-production support activities.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve business processes, project delivery, service quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Encourage collaboration and help establish a shared understanding of evolving business requirements and project needs.
  • Communicate project updates, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding issues to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple assignments, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines in a changing project environment.
  • Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Specifications

Education and Experience


Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, IT Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Technical Business Analyst.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business and functional requirements.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders and technology teams.
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process documentation, and business requirements.
  • Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or similar environment.


Preferred

  • Experience supporting data teams or working on data-related projects.
  • Experience with data warehousing, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, data integration, or data management initiatives.
  • General familiarity with structured data, data quality, reporting requirements, and business rules.
  • Experience with reporting or business intelligence tools such as Tableau or BusinessObjects.
  • Experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Six Sigma certification or process-improvement experience.


Skills and Abilities

Required

  • Strong business analysis, requirements-gathering, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to understand business processes and translate business needs into viable technology solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • General understanding of technology projects, systems, data flows, integrations, reporting, and software delivery processes.
  • Ability to facilitate meetings, requirements sessions, workshops, and cross-functional discussions.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
  • Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain business requirements and technology concepts to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation.
  • Detail orientation and the ability to deliver accurate, high-quality work.
  • Ability to work effectively within an Agile team environment.
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple tasks, clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to new processes, systems, teams, and methods.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity and evolving requirements.
  • Ability to appropriately balance priorities, deadlines, risks, and project deliverables.


Technical Expectations

The Senior IT Business Analyst should be comfortable working in a technology environment and collaborating with developers, data engineers, architects, quality assurance professionals, and reporting teams. The position does not require the individual to be a developer, data engineer, or advanced technical specialist.

Basic familiarity with SQL, databases, reporting systems, data warehousing, or data analysis is beneficial, but the primary emphasis of the role is business analysis, stakeholder communication, requirements management, process understanding, and successful project delivery.
